asked.item: Does moving a scheduled post to drafts publish it by accident?
Is changing only the time a different button?

verdict.reason: S39, S103, S41, S90 and S94 directly answer both questions.

steps.text: No, moving a scheduled post to drafts removes the schedule without publishing it.
Yes, to change only the time, use Reschedule instead of Move to drafts.
In Posts > Scheduled, select Reschedule on the post, choose the new date and time, then select Save, and the post stays scheduled.
